lines.text: The first TV station in sub-Saharan Africa wasn't in Lagos. It was in Ibadan.
On October thirty first, 1959, Western Nigeria Television, WNTV, went on air.
It was launched by the Western Region government, led by Chief Obafemi Awolowo.
Its proud slogan was: First in Africa.
And it came almost a full year before Nigeria's independence.
